title: The owner's own challenge, its winners and the leaderboard hiding are never opened in a test
what: Only the ready-made challenge cards are driven in a browser test. The New challenge form, cancelling a challenge, giving or skipping a winner's free days, copying the winners list and hiding a member on the leaderboard are checked only as server rules or word lists, never on the screen.
expected: A browser test makes a challenge, sees the toast and the card, cancels one, gives and skips a winner, and hides then shows a member on the leaderboard.
fix_line: Add one browser test that walks the owner's challenge screen end to end

title: Diet plans and body measurements are tested only as the owner, though the desk and trainers use them
what: The browser test for measurements and diet plans says "the trainer" in its title but runs signed in as the owner. No test signs in as front desk or a trainer and sends a plan or saves a measurement on screen; only the server test checks that a desk session may save.
expected: A browser test signs in as a trainer and as front desk, saves a measurement and sends a diet plan, and sees the same toasts.
fix_line: Add a trainer and a desk sign-in to the diet and measurements test

title: The Busy machines settings page is never opened by a browser test
what: Busy machines (the counts, the switch, Save, the owner-only view for staff and the empty list) is checked only through its helper rules and the server test. No test opens the page, saves it, or looks at it as staff.
expected: A browser test opens Busy machines as the owner, changes a count, saves, sees "Saved." and "No changes to save.", and opens it as staff read-only.
fix_line: Add a browser test for the Busy machines page

title: Stopping a workout offer and the staff view of it are never seen in a test
what: The workout offer test starts an offer, gives a reward and takes it back, all as the owner. Stopping the offer, switching to "given by themselves", the staff page with no start or stop controls, the "owner gives the extra days" line and the "already has the reward" toast are never shown on screen; staff refusals are only server checks.
expected: A browser test stops an offer, switches the giving mode, and signs in as staff to see no owner controls and the already-rewarded toast.
fix_line: Extend the offer test with stop, mode change and a staff sign-in

title: No test opens Enquiries as staff, and the quick add button is never tapped
what: Every Enquiries browser test is signed in as the owner. Nothing checks that staff see no "Give free days" button, no money totals and no other branch's enquiries, or that the quick button opens the Add enquiry sheet. A follow-up day in the past being refused is not tested either.
expected: A browser test signs in as staff on Enquiries, uses the quick add button, and checks the give button and money are hidden; another refuses a past follow-up day.
fix_line: Add a staff sign-in and the quick button to the enquiries test

title: Importing members as staff is never tried on screen
what: The import screen is tested only as the owner. That staff get members only, with plans and payments held for the owner, no AI call, no Undo list and no money, is checked only as helper rules; no test signs in as staff and imports a file.
expected: A browser test imports the same file as staff and then as the owner, and sees the staff words, no AI line, no Past imports, then plans and payments added once.
fix_line: Add a staff import then owner import browser test

title: The half-finished import and failed undo messages are never tested
what: No test shows the line for an import whose plans or payments partly failed, the "not fully undone, tap Undo again" line, the "Undoing" button state, or the line that only the first rows of a big file were taken. These are the words that stop an owner from bringing payments in twice.
expected: Tests make a plan or payment save fail half way and an undo fail half way, and check each message and that a second try counts each payment once.
how_often: rare, but costly when it happens
fix_line: Add failure cases for import and undo

title: Nothing checks what staff see of the owner's help questions and support access on a shared desk browser
what: The help questions list and the bell's seen marks are kept per browser. No test checks whether staff on the desk browser see the owner's questions and answers, or that the MettleUp access card is hidden from staff.
expected: A test signs in as owner, asks a question and opens support access, then signs in as staff on the same browser and checks what is and is not shown.
how_often: every day at a shared desk
fix_line: Add a shared-browser owner then staff test

title: The old What's new address is never opened in a test
what: The page used to live under Settings. Nothing opens the old address to check it still lands on What's new rather than a blank page.
expected: A test opens the old address and sees the What's new page.
fix_line: Add one line to the What's new test

title: Most Add expense refusals and month switching are never tested
what: Only the future-date refusal is tested. An empty, zero or odd amount, a wrong year, "Keep it" on remove, and moving between months (with Next month off on the current one) are never checked.
expected: Tests try each wrong amount and date, tap Keep it, and step back a month and forward again.
fix_line: Add the refusal and month steps to the expenses test

title: Gym timings failure, offline and staff empty states are never tested
what: The timings test covers a good save, refusals and removal. A save that fails (Saved must not show), the offline or read-failed lines with Try again, the staff "No timings yet." view and staff seeing a change made on another device are not tested.
expected: Tests make the save fail, open the page offline, and open it as staff with nothing saved and after the owner changes it.
fix_line: Add failure, offline and staff-empty cases to the timings test
